criteria.criterion_rationale: Precontact Euler truncation bound is 0.5*a_parallel*t*dt=0.00327m at 0.2s, hence 0.004m; velocity is constant-acceleration reference. Guide/rotation bounds are absolute SI errors at one-body float32 scale. 15mm permits roughly two contact-time vertical increments (~7.4mm each), but catches unresolved penetration. Tail 10mm/0.05m/s and energy +0.05J are scenario-specific, predeclared physical limits, not solver tolerances.
criteria.pair_comparison: Report complete differences; no required winner or minimum effect. Physical pass/fail is judged per backend. Tail position difference <=0.005m and velocity difference <=0.02m/s support only narrow agreement; disagreement is a valid negative result, not grounds to change protocol.
criteria.terminal_convergence: Record fraction and all r_p/r_d/r_c arrays separately. Do not compare same-named residuals as identical or use converged alone as physical correctness. Physical criteria may fail despite converged. No universal common residual acceptance threshold.
